regressionChecked: every path into http-proxy: only dispatcher (after prepareProxiedRequest) and ws-upgrade (after prepareUpgradeRequest); sole createProxyMiddleware call; guarded wrapper 500s requests with no forward context; forwardContexts.set only in prepare-request.ts
http-proxy 1.18.1 builds outgoing headers from req.headers (not rawHeaders), so sanitising req.headers is effective; Expect removed; connection forced to close unless upgrade
header case/duplicate/array tricks: removeAnyCase, node lowercases and joins duplicates, applyForwardHeaders drops every x-user-* key and overwrites x-forwarded-*, x-real-ip, authorization
Connection-listed header smuggling: connection header is rewritten to close, upstreams are direct (no intermediary honouring it), x-user-* already removed
Expect: 100-continue bypass closed on HTTP and WS (live spoof matrix direct and nginx, with and without Expect per temper)

body-cap: counts bytes on the incoming stream via req.pipe, destroys upstream at cap, 413 keep-alive, drain bounded by cap+8MB and 5s timer unref'd and cleared on close; onProxyError suppressed for over-cap

SessionRevoker: deactivation and outbox event in one transaction, gRPC fast path after commit, logout fallback on tx failure; gateway SessionRevokedHandler idempotent, dedupe:false, skips expired exp, malformed payload permanent error
auth_events.proto SessionRevoked additive (int64 as string); rabbitmq gateway user permissions
revoke hooks: logout, device delete, logout-all-others, change and reset password

findings.summary: 413 from the Content-Length guard path has no bounded drain: Node dumps the declared body on a keep-alive socket until requestTimeout. Only the streamed-cap path has the 8MB/5s bound. Reuse capRequestBody's drain bound or set Connection: close after the response. Mitigated by nginx 100M cap, rate limiter and loopback-only port

Denylist scrubs only x-user-*, forwarded, x-real-ip, x-internal-service-token; x-forwarded-port/prefix/server and x-original-url from clients still reach upstreams. Harmless today; consider removing or an allowlist
One outbox insert per session in a loop inside the transaction (password reset with many sessions); batch with createMany if OutboxService allows
POST /auth/exchange is @Public in auth but routed under required auth; never proxied before, no client uses it
No Origin check on WS upgrade; SameSite=Lax mitigates today
gateway on non-internal edge network has outbound internet it does not need
